prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Mexican woman — the personification of Mexico City — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Mexico City as her world knows it — a city of a myth-world on a high mountain lake: white stone and carved pale wood, glazed painted tiles, canals crossed by little arched bridges, strings of lace-fine cut-silk banners, lantern-light and drifting spirit lights, marigolds and blossoms with softly glowing petals. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the volcanoes, the hilltop castle or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: a warm bakery of the capital — wooden shelves heaped with round sweet buns crowned with crackly sugar tops scored like seashells, golden twists and little loaves, the smell of fresh bread in the air.
Around her, as her world makes them: a round sweet bun with a crackly sugar top scored like a seashell, on a little glazed plate; a woven willow basket; a few silver and gold coins.
Season: the cool dry season — but she is indoors: show the season only through a window or in her clothing; no blossoms, petals, falling leaves, snow or trees inside the room.
Time of day: the evening rush after work — the warm low sun sinking into dusk and lamps coming on along the street; low gold light through the window, long warm stripes across the walls.
Hair: her hair in two low, loose twin tails — same colour and length as the attached image.
Light direction: backlit — the main light comes from behind her, a bright rim along her hair and shoulders.
Outfit: a leather work apron over a sleeveless fitted top and slim work trousers, gauntlet gloves tucked in the belt — in a clear pattern such as a floral print, bold stripes, gingham or plaid, in two or three cheerful colours; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 40-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 25-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather and other heavy materials stay opaque; styled with a tweed newsboy cap, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress, not regalia — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of hand-woven linen, silk, cotton and wool, with laced, tied or hooked closures, embroidered hems and soft leather shoes or boots; nothing synthetic, no zips, no printed logos.
POSTURE: standing close to a high shelf or line, reaching up to it.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body turned three-quarters away from the camera; head turned to the side; camera at her eye level; her shoulders, chest and hips turn away from the camera together, no twist at the waist; her chest stays turned away; she is placed in the right third of the frame, open space of the place to her left; a soft out-of-focus object of the place sits in the near foreground at one edge of the frame.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right arm reaches up, the hand on the shelf or line above her head — her near arm, on the image's right side toward the camera; one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty — her far arm, on the image's left side, mostly hidden behind her body — at most its hand shows beside her hip.
LEGS: weight even on both legs.
GAZE: her eyes are lowered.
EXPRESSION: level lowered brow, steady unblinking eyes, mouth closed in a straight line, jaw set.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a slender silver wand wound with a living flowering vine whose tips glow softly — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.

Avoid: Nothing from our present day in her world: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, jeans, hologram, billboard, car, machinery, denim, bomber jacket, cowboy hat, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles, sunglasses, bucket hat, beanie, sun visor, acetate.
